news.headline:
SJ Corporation has submitted an application to BSE seeking a no objection for reclassifying promoters Savji D Patel and Ushaben Savjibhai Patel from Outgoing Promoter and Promoter Group to Public Category.

The decision follows the company's Board Meeting held on October 03, 2026, with the formal application subsequently filed with BSE on October 07, 2026.

Source: ScoutQuest

news.headline:
S&P Global Ratings has reaffirmed Union Bank of India's Issuer Credit Ratings at 'BBB/Stable/A-2' with a Stable outlook, while maintaining its stand-alone credit profile at 'bbb-'.

The stable outlook reflects expectations that the bank will maintain a steady capital cushion with risk-adjusted capital above 7% over 12-24 months, supported by stable earnings and very high likelihood of government support.

Source: BSE

news.headline:
Dhanuka Agritech has launched Fujita, a systemic fungicide to control rice blast disease in paddy crops.

The fungicide aims to effectively manage rice blast, helping maintain crop health and protect paddy yield potential.

Source: The Hindu BusinessLine

news.headline:
S.J.S. Enterprises plans a ~20% capacity expansion at its Bengaluru facility, investing Rs 45 crore via internal accruals.

Commercial production is expected by Q3 FY27, with existing capacity utilisation standing at ~75%.

Source: ScoutQuest
